title: List the long names of teams that had above-average build-up play passing i
question: List the long names of teams that had above-average build-up play passing in 2015 and whose league was among the top 4 leagues with the most matches in the 2015/2016 season.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_leagues AS (
  SELECT "XCL_008" AS league_id
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE "XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY "XCL_008"
  ORDER BY COUNT("XCL_006") DESC
  LIMIT 4
),
avg_buildup AS (
  SELECT AVG("XCL_181") AS avg_passing
  FROM "Team_Attributes"
  WHERE "XCL_178" LIKE '2015%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT t."XCL_173"
FROM "Team" AS t
INNER JOIN "Team_Attributes" AS ta ON t."XCL_171" = ta."XCL_177"
INNER JOIN "Match" AS m ON t."XCL_171" = m."XCL_013" OR t."XCL_171" = m."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN top_leagues AS tl ON m."XCL_008" = tl.league_id
WHERE ta."XCL_178" LIKE '2015%'
  AND ta."XCL_181" > (SELECT avg_passing FROM avg_buildup)
